profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company, traded under the ticker STX, with headquarters listed in Singapore. Its website describes it as a leader in mass-capacity data storage, stating that it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. The company says it makes storage that scales and brings trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

On AI, Seagate's site says it is optimizing storage for AI, making what it describes as unprecedented leaps forward in capacity to support efficient data center architecture and buildout. It points to five strategic shifts that it says can help close the gap between AI's growing data demands and infrastructure readiness, and notes that people and machines will create data in more ways and at a faster pace as AI proliferates.

The record holds no tracked products, lawsuits, or MCP servers for the company. Its profile lists it as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001137789.
